comment: Programs the C/C++ -> Java judge runs (tools/judge_c_java.py). Paths are absolute or relative to this folder; a 'glob' entry is one program per file. 'prepend' is text put before the source when it is staged (K&R tests that print through MS-DOS bdos(2, c) get putchar), 'cut_eof' cuts a DOS file at its Ctrl-Z, 'std' is clang's -std. Where a program is not on this machine it is skipped and the table says so.
